dependencies.image_authoring: No workflow installs Pillow/NumPy. Density/header native gates require neither. Actual capture and paired-image tools remain separate authoring work.

portability_and_resource_limits.finding: .gitattributes applies * text=auto eol=lf; exact pinned fixture SHA therefore is not intentionally rewritten to CRLF. Both native frame emitters have checked _setmode(...,_O_BINARY) paths.

New fixture/test text is ASCII and the native target uses existing C++20 /W4 /WX /permissive- configuration. Target-file generator expressions select Release executables. Actual new-fixture compilation and execution remain unobserved in hosted MSVC.

Existing Windows Unicode checkout step builds/runs only the starter generator with standalone OFF. It does not qualify native density/header build roots or actual fifteen-view utility paths. No native Unicode claim is made.

Both macos-15 and macos-15-intel are explicit separate runner entries in all three platform matrices. Static analysis and earlier base execution cannot establish the changed header C++20 helper lookup, warning cleanliness, floating-point/raster behavior or live Cocoa/device operation.

Native sanitizer job remains 20 minutes including dependencies/build/serial testing. New density/header properties remain 240/480 seconds, existing child guards remain binding, and no actual new sanitizer elapsed time is established. Observe fit without weakening test workloads or leak checks.

Hosted native jobs use dummy drivers; ordinary app smoke is selected but the optional fifteen-view utility is not. Full actual H1 captures, paired comparison and independent visual review remain root-owned acceptance.
